lines.description: IC CRT VIDEO TIMER AND CONTROLLER (VTAC), 40-PIN DIP, +5V/+12V
lines.notes: Tube 1 of 2. Standard Microsystems CRT 5027/5037/5057 VTAC datasheet, in the 1982 SMC data catalog (19 MB; the VTAC section is the datasheet). Reads: PACKAGE: 40-Pin D.I.P.; operating temperature range 0 C to +70 C. Dual supply - Vcc = +5 V +/-5% and Vdd = +12 V +/-5% - so Supply Voltage Min/Max are left off rather than record only one rail. No manufacturer given on the source, so none recorded; CRT5037 is Standard Microsystems' part number.

lines.description: IC EEPROM 64K (8K x 8) PARALLEL 28-PIN PLASTIC DIP
lines.notes: One tube. Xicor 1987 data book: X2864A is an 8K x 8 E2PROM, 28 pins, TA = 0 C to +70 C, Vcc = +5 V +/-5%; ordering information gives P = Plastic DIP. The -32 suffix is NOT listed anywhere in that book - Xicor's speed grades for this part are -25 (250 ns), blank (300 ns), -35 and -45, and Octopart lists only X2864AP, -25, -35 and -45. Marking transcribed as given; please re-check the tube label.
